content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Because these symptoms are intermittent and continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is needed, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. Authorization is on file, and reconsideration of the PR-204 denial is requested based on this documented clinical indication."}
